kit_properties: Every number in every draft matches the Fact Sheet or a story's own numbers.
No draft names a person whose story marks them as not to be named.
No sentence uses any of these words: passionate, journey, impactful, disruptive, scalable, stakeholders, empowered, transformational, a natural leader, I inspired them.

The goals essay names the short-term goal specifically: Product or implementation at an education technology company selling to public school systems in Brazil, owning the part that meets teachers: what a classroom can actually run, how a rollout is trained, what gets measured.
The leadership essay leads with "The twenty minutes on the door", or the Strategist says why another story is stronger.
The setback essay leads with "The app I talked everyone into", or the Strategist says why another story is stronger.
